title: swarm.InlineSwarmBase
description:
An inline swarm base definition (without computed ID or metadata).

Contains a list of agent configurations that will be validated, deduplicated,
and sorted when converting to an [`InlineSwarm`].

agents.description: The LLMs in this swarm, with optional counts and fallbacks.

weights.description: Optional weights for each agent. If `None`, uniform weights are used.
